data.report: Finland Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 club/venue gap supplement: 21 checklist rows resolved against fi/en Wikipedia season tables, Veikkausliiga grounds list, OpenStreetMap Nominatim and Mapcarta. Key resolutions: FC Lahti entry-year 1990 belongs to predecessors Kuusysi/Reipas (FC Lahti founded 1996, first top flight 1999); FinnPa venues are Töölön pallokenttä + Helsingin olympiastadion (the-sports.org 'Finnair Stadium' is anachronistic); OTP venue is season-keyed Raatti (top-flight era) vs Heinäpää Sports Centre (current); TPV venue is season-keyed old Tammelan Stadion (until 2020) vs Kauppi 3 (current); Kumu venue is Kuusankosken Urheilupuisto (Arto Tolsa Areena rejected); FC Hämeenlinna is Kauriala (Helsinki Olympiastadion mapping rejected); Ekenäs IF stadium verified as Ekenäs Sparbank Arena (59.97352, 23.44307). official_round/meeting_number delegated to req-20261004-003; home/away_standing unavailable (no dated pre-kickoff snapshots in public sources).

value.rejected_mapping: the-sports.org 'Finnair Stadium' is anachronistic (stadium opened 2000; FinnPa folded 1998)

rows.field_locator: History: 'Lahti was founded in 1996 when two rival clubs – Kuusysi and Reipas Lahti – decided to merge'; 'played its first season in 1997 in Ykkönen'; promoted to highest tier for 1999

'Kisapuisto' is the surrounding sports park (Olympedia https://www.olympedia.org/venues/384: Lahden Kisapuisto 60.986389,25.650278, sports-park level) – not the stadium itself.

Value must NOT be stored on the FC Lahti entity; attribute 1990 to predecessor if the schema supports it.
